description.value: 🔥 UNDERLAND ESSIGFABRIK – Der Start einer neuen Ära! 🔥 Bereit für den Vibe, der NRW zum Beben bringt? Rheinaudio präsentiert euch ein brandneues Kapitel in der Geschichte der härtesten Beats: UNDERLAND ESSIGFABRIK! Am Samstag, den 05. September 2026, öffnen sich die Tore zu einer Dimension, die ihr so noch nicht erlebt habt. Das ist nicht nur ein Event, das ist der Auftakt von etwas ganz Großem! Seit 2010 stehen wir für „Quality Events“, und jetzt zünden wir die nächste Stufe. Holt eure Rave-Crew zusammen, denn wir tauchen ab in das Underland der Essigfabrik! Zwei Floors, Eine Mission: Abriss Total! Die Essigfabrik Köln und die Elektroküche werden zu eurem persönlichen Spielplatz für Hardtechno und Uptempo. Zwei Floors, zwölf Artists – eine Mission: Euch in Ekstase zu versetzen. Erlebt die pure Energie und die rohe Kraft der Musik, die uns alle antreibt. Von den ersten Beats bis zum Morgengrauen wird hier keine Sekunde stillgestanden! Das Lineup, das euch zerlegt! 🎶 Wir haben für euch eine Selektion an Artists zusammengestellt, die wissen, wie man einen Floor zum Kochen bringt. Hier ist das Team, das euch ins Underland entführt: Sichert euch euer Ticket ins Underland! 🎟️ Das hier ist der Start von etwas Großem, und ihr wollt von Anfang an dabei sein! Die Nachfrage wird enorm sein, also zögert nicht. Sichert euch eure Tickets und seid Teil dieser Premiere. Alle Infos und Tickets findet ihr auf . Seid schnell, bevor es zu spät ist! Wir sehen uns im Chaos! 🎉 Packt eure Tanzschuhe ein, bereitet euch auf eine Nacht voller unvergesslicher Momente vor und lasst uns gemeinsam das Underland erobern. Am Samstag, 05. September 2026, wird die Essigfabrik zum Epizentrum der harten Sounds. Affenkäfig lädt ein – seid ihr bereit für den Abriss? Wir können es kaum erwarten, mit euch die Wände zum Wackeln zu bringen! Let’s go! 🔥 UNDERLAND ESSIGFABRIK – Der Start einer neuen Ära! 🔥 🔥 UNDERLAND ESSIGFABRIK – Der Start einer neuen Ära! 🔥

description.value:
BLACKLIST & INURFASE pres.

ZAAGSTEP by Dr Donk

For years, electronic music has been built on genres.

Zaag. Uptempo. Hard Dance. Dubstep. Drum & Bass. Bass Music.

But what happens when the boundaries between them disappear?

On September 11th, BLACKLIST and INURFASE invite you to witness the official launch of ZAAGSTEP - the sound created by Dr Donk that combines the high BPM intensity of Uptempo and Zaag with the energy, and influence of Bass Music.

A never-seen-before crossover between Dubstep, Zaag, Drum & Bass, Uptempo and everything in between. WELCOME TO ZAAGSTEP 😈

To celebrate his upcoming album release, Dr Donk presents the world's first full-scale ZAAGSTEP showcase at Bootshaus Cologne, featuring artists who have helped shape the sound and artists who represent the different worlds colliding within it.

Welcome to Chrome Cologne Chrome Cologne is a place for music, creativity, and freedom. At its core is an immersive hard techno experience where people come together to dance, express themselves, and enjoy the moment. As a sex-positive event, Chrome Cologne also offers an optional playroom. Participation is entirely voluntary. No one is expected or pressured to take part. The dancefloor remains the heart of the event. Awareness Comes First Creating a respectful and as safe as possible environment for all guests is our highest priority. Our Awareness Team is present throughout the entire event and can be easily identified by their printed Awareness shirts and blue LED lights. In addition, there is an Awareness Point located at the entrance of the playroom, where a team member will always be available to assist you. If you feel uncomfortable, experience harassment, or need help for any reason, please speak to us at any time. If you notice someone who may need support, we appreciate you informing our team as well. In addition to the Awareness Team, you can also approach the bar staff, cloakroom staff, or security personnel. Playroom Rules The playroom is a protected space for consensual encounters. The following rules apply without exception: Consent is key. Only a clear "yes" means yes. Always ask before observing, touching, or joining others. Respect personal boundaries without discussion. Treat all guests with respect and discretion. No drinks are allowed inside the playroom. Violations of these rules will be addressed consistently by our team. Dress Code Chrome Cologne is built on individuality and artistic expression. The dress code is an integral part of the concept and will be checked at the entrance. Examples of welcome attire include: Fetish wear Latex Leather Rubber Metal elements Masks Kinky fashion Creative and unconventional looks Bold and stylish outfits This list serves as guidance and is not exhaustive. What matters is not a single item of clothing, but the overall impression of your outfit and a visible engagement with the event's concept. The following are not permitted: Everyday clothing Regular jeans Cargo pants Tank tops Tracksuits Basic rave outfits without creative expression Cotton underwear Simple skirts or basic fashion made from everyday standard materials without a creative connection to the concept The dress code does not mean that you must show skin or dress revealingly. Creativity, personality, and a willingness to be part of the overall concept are what matter most. Our experienced entrance and sorting team will evaluate each outfit individually within the overall context of the event. The decision of the staff is final and binding. Guests who do not meet the dress code requirements will not be admitted to the event. Changing facilities and a cloakroom are available on site. If you are unsure about your outfit, feel free to bring an alternative. You may also contact us up to 24 hours before the event at outfit@chromecologne.com. Phone-Free Event A strict no-phone policy applies throughout the entire event. Smartphones must be checked in at the cloakroom unless there is a medical necessity requiring access to the device. In such cases, stickers will be provided to cover the phone's cameras. Guests who violate the phone policy will be required to leave the event. Together We Create the Space Chrome Cologne thrives on mutual respect, openness, and mindfulness. Look out for one another, support each other, and help create a space where everyone feels welcome, respected, and comfortable. Age for Admission 18 years / Einlass ab 18 Jahren! KitKatClub Cologne ist eine authentische Adaption des 1994 gegründeten und in Berlin ansässigen KitKatClub. Unangefochten einer der fantasievollsten Undergroundclubs weltweit, definiert sich der KitKatClub als avantgardistischer Nachtclub, der die Traditionen der „verruchten“ Berliner Clubs der „Goldenen Zwanziger“ aufgreift. Somit fusioniert der KitKatClub multimediale und künstlerische Elemente zum innovativen Konzept im Sinne des avantgardistischen Zeitgeistes.

The High Priestess of Hard Techno is coming to Bootshaus.

On December 11th, one of the most defining artists of the new generation of hard techno takes over Bootshaus: Sara Landry.

DJ, producer, label head and one of the most powerful forces in electronic music right now — Sara Landry has built a world that goes far beyond BPM and distorted kicks.
